coverage_explanation: Tests fan-off and fan-on behavior, the two ADC codes bracketing 30°C, a higher temperature, repeated threshold crossings, and return to cold. Uses the authoritative analog-input remapping to A0. Fan-on duty cycle is not specified, so any nonzero PWM output is accepted.
assumptions: The authoritative hardware configuration remaps the source's A1 temperature input to A0; the fan remains on D5.
The LM35 uses its nominal 10 mV/°C conversion. The disclosed bench default ADC reference is 5 V with raw readings 0..1023.
The fan control is active HIGH: zero PWM is off and nonzero PWM is on. No particular on-state duty cycle is specified.
Exactly 30°C is not representable as an integer ADC code under this conversion. ADC 61 is approximately 29.81°C and ADC 62 is approximately 30.30°C, bracketing the strict threshold.
